item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Nikdotos #9637 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Nikdotos #9637 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to Iolcus. Nikdotos is the mourner now.
